Thanks for confirming, Maria — glad Zoom worked and appreciated the quick join.

Short-term actions (completed):
- Zoom fallback used for today's session (Ben created temporary Zoom link).
- I regenerated the calendar event from my account and re-sent the invite; you should receive an updated event shortly (regen_invite.ics was used).

Long-term recommended approach:
- For external, cross-domain partners, prefer the organizer to be the individual (not a delegated inbox) — that reduces Meet guest-block behavior.
- If Meet must be used, make sure 'Guests can join' is enabled on the organizer's G Suite settings and avoid room/delegated organizers for partner-facing invites.
- We can also publish a recommended cadence: Meet by default but create an automatic Zoom fallback link in the event description for partners that historically see guest blocks. Redwood can provide a standard 'fallback' template we include in invites.

I'll follow up with a short doc and a calendar template we can use going forward. Thanks again for your time today — I'll loop in an AE to continue the conversation on pricing and next steps.
